THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
093
STUDY 010
Chocolate Turtleneck & Striped Skirt
Rights check
Source: 5028.jpg
Cozy, textured, 90s-inspired
WORKING NOTES
- The striped knit skirt with fuzzy trim is the focal point; keep the band colors
specific.
- Add "full-length" if you want the drawstring pom-poms visible.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the drawstring pom-poms.
IMAGE PROMPT
A vertical studio fashion portrait of an original
young woman with light brown, straight hair and full
bangs, swept slightly to one side with loose strands
blowing across her shoulder. She wears a fitted
chocolate-brown long-sleeved turtleneck with a
softly ruched center front and contrast stitching at
the cuffs, layered with a pearl necklace that has a
small silver charm at the center. Her hands rest on
her hips. She wears a knit midi skirt in horizontal
bands of raspberry pink and chocolate brown,
edged with fuzzy turquoise trim, with a drawstring
waistband ending in fluffy brown pom-poms. Her
expression is calm and direct, with light blush on
her cheeks. Soft, even studio lighting against a
pale gray-white seamless backdrop, a palette of
chocolate, raspberry, and turquoise accents.
Textured, cozy, and nostalgic, in the style of a
1990s-inspired knitwear lookbook.
